title: SQL 条件报表 (CASE & Reporting)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (10/16)：复杂布尔条件、CASE WHEN、条件计数、条件求和与 ROLLUP 报表写法

content.tips: 查 users：age 不小于 18，且 city 为 Beijing 或 Shanghai（OR 部分加括号）
content.content: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age >= 18 AND (city = 'Beijing' OR city = 'Shanghai');

content.tips: 查 users：用 NOT 排除 status 为 banned 或 deleted 的行
content.content: SELECT * FROM users WHERE NOT (status = 'banned' OR status = 'deleted');

content.tips: 查 orders：status 为 paid 或 shipped（加括号），且 amount 大于 100
content.content: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE (status = 'paid' OR status = 'shipped') AND amount > 100;

content.tips: 查 users 的 name，再用 CASE WHEN 按 age 分档：小于 18 为 minor、小于 60 为 adult、其余 senior，别名 age_group
content.content: SELECT name, CASE WHEN age < 18 THEN 'minor' WHEN age < 60 THEN 'adult' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_group FROM users;

content.tips: 查 orders 全部，ORDER BY 里用 CASE status：paid 排 1、pending 排 2、其余 3
content.content: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'paid' THEN 1 WHEN 'pending' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

content.tips: users 按 city、status 两列分组，输出这两列和行数
content.content: SELECT city, status, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY city, status;

content.tips: 查 users 总行数别名 total，再用 SUM+CASE 统计 status 为 active 的条数，别名 active_count
content.content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM users;

content.tips: orders 用 SUM+CASE 分别统计 status 为 paid（别名 paid）和 pending（别名 pending）的条数
content.content: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM orders;

content.tips: orders 按 user_id 分组，用 SUM+CASE 只累加 status 为 paid 的 amount，别名 paid_total
content.content: SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid_total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id;

content.tips: orders 按 user_id 分组求 amount 和别名 total，筛 total 大于 1000，再按 total 降序
content.content: SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING total > 1000 ORDER BY total DESC;

content.tips: users 按 city 分组统计行数，并用 WITH ROLLUP 输出小计
content.content: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY city WITH ROLLUP;
